## Block Markup

This is a [**static block**](https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). The markup is saved directly in the post content.

```html
<!-- wp:nextpage -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:nextpage -->
```
